projects.title: E-Voting System Using Blockchain
projects.client: University of Karachi (Department of Computer Science)
projects.summary: A secure, transparent and efficient electoral platform built on a decentralized ledger.
description: The Blockchain-based Electronic Voting System addresses the persistent challenges of traditional voting by leveraging blockchain technology. The platform ensures a secure, transparent and efficient electoral process, reducing risks such as voter fraud, ballot manipulation and inefficiencies.

It introduces dual-role functionality: voters can access election details, view candidates and track their participation history, while administrators manage candidate lists, voter records and election results.

highlights.title: Enhanced Security
highlights.text: Blockchain ensures tamper-proof voting records, reducing the risk of fraud and manipulation.

highlights.title: Transparency & Trust
highlights.text: Every vote is recorded on a public ledger, providing verifiable results that build voter confidence.

highlights.title: Efficiency & Accessibility
highlights.text: Digital voting speeds up counting, minimizes errors and is inclusive for voters with disabilities.

highlights.title: Immutable Record Keeping
highlights.text: Transactions stored on the blockchain cannot be altered, keeping electoral data permanent and accurate.

projects.title: Industrial AI Dashboard (YTML) — Mobile
projects.summary: Compliance monitoring for an industrial setting, on the go.
description: An Industrial AI Dashboard designed for monitoring and compliance in an industrial setting. Compliance metrics are shown with pie charts across three categories: Overall, Admin and House Keeping compliance.

Below these, the dashboard lists House Keeping and Admin alerts — pallets, cardboard, trolleys, garbage, emergencies, wrong parking, crowd presence and intruders — each with incident counts and percentages. It is part of a larger system by The Disrupt Labs.

projects.title: Real Estate Finder
projects.summary: Search properties by location, price, type and bedrooms — built with ReactJS.
description: Users can search for properties by location and filter results by price, type (house or apartment), number of bedrooms and place. A clean UI makes finding your dream home easier than ever.

The project covers ReactJS fundamentals — functional components, hooks such as useState, useEffect and useContext, React Icons and React Router — and works with a large property dataset. It is fully responsive across devices.
